product.name: Managed PostgreSQL
product.description: A managed PostgreSQL database service offering backups, high availability, scaling, and connection pooling.

product.name: Ubicloud Compute
product.description: Dedicated virtual machines on bare metal providers with encryption for compute or memory intensive workloads.

product.name: GitHub Actions Integration
product.description: Managed runners for GitHub Actions providing isolated, ephemeral VMs to reduce CI costs.

product.name: Elastic Compute
product.description: Infrastructure-as-a-Service feature to provision, use, and delete isolated virtual machines on bare metal.

product.name: Virtual Networking
product.description: Public and private networking with IPv4 and IPv6, flexible firewall rules, load balancing, and encryption in transit.

product.name: Block Storage
product.description: Non-replicated block storage devices with encryption at rest for cloud infrastructure.
